# Favorites

Show favorite pages on the dashboard and pinned pages in the sidebar.

![Favorites preview](/assets/plugins/favorites/preview.png)

- Plugin ID: `me.kumbuka.favorites`
- Source version: `1.0.11`
- Permissions: `activity:read`

[Source](https://github.com/kumbuka-me/plugins/tree/main/favorites) · [Releases](https://github.com/kumbuka-me/plugins/releases?q=favorites%2Fv) · [Installation](../../administration/plugins.md)

Favorites shows the current viewer's favorite pages on Home and, when enabled in personal navigation preferences, as pinned sidebar shortcuts.

## Permissions

- `activity:read` reads favorite pages already visible to the current viewer.
